title: Beautyworld Dubai moves to Expo City Dubai for its 2027 edition
summary: The next edition of Beautyworld Dubai will take place at the Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC), at Expo City Dubai, from October 19 to 21, 2027. The move will provide the show with expanded exhibition space, said the organizers. “The beauty industry in this region has grown remarkably, and with it the needs of the businesses that come to Beautyworld Dubai to meet, launch and trade,” said Teresa Heitor, Portfolio Director - Consumer Goods, Messe Frankfurt Middle East. “Dubai Exhibition Centre... - Industry buzz / Africa / Middle East
